purpose: Coupled turbine plant (JSBSim <plant>) for the F-35B's F135: fuel, combustion, matched gas path, shafts, nozzle, metal temperatures and the LiftSystem in one transient; replaces the empirical wet-thrust tables and thermal observer for this aircraft only.

source.nativeContract: doc/turbine-plant-model.md in the JSBSim repository at this commit
source.validationManifest: utils/turbine_plant/validation.json in the JSBSim repository at this commit

toolchain.emscripten: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.9-git

defects: propulsion/set-running put a plant engine at full throttle (FGPropulsion::SetEngineRunning writes its own throttle copy) until the next step, which could light an augmentor the FCS inhibits
the first step of an engine at rest in moving air could exhaust the 16-iteration cap and fail
unestablished metal took the 288.15 K reference rather than the local ambient

the steady solve failed into any lift-fan conversion above about 15 kt (a stopped fan passed no ram flow, so the residual jumped where the continuation starts), so zero-time conversion and set-running kept the previous state, including a burning augmentor
the bypass-entry surrogate followed the clutch alone: 1 % conversion at full throttle left the core at 83 % N2
the thrust-split loop switched on and off at 2 % of design thrust as a cut-off lift fan spooled down
the augmentor minimum N2 was a physical speed, so a full-power F135 held static above about 15,000 ft could never select reheat

nativeSuite.scope: Full ctest of the native build at this commit, including FGTurbinePlantTest (33 methods), TestTurbinePlant, the empirical turbine tests and every other JSBSim test.

abOnset.summary: 0 s of wet thrust without burned reheat fuel in all three scenarios (was 4.1333 s); worst step energy residual 1.2e-7

reducedVersusComponent.summary: five trajectories (stand cold start to reheat and cutoff, hot-day high start, 25,000 ft 400 kt, windmill cutoff and relight, STOVL conversion and closing): worst normalized force/spool/fuel difference 1.3e-6, worst temperature difference 0.0014 K, every event in the same step

preservation.previousArtifact: Immutable fork.16 archive retained; it remains in the accepted list.
preservation.matchingEngineData: The fork.16 package, lock, identity module and the F-35B data at 0sfs d92a928a (empirical F135, liftfan and sidefan engines) are retained in the rollback declaration; the plant F135 needs fork.20 or newer.

limitations: Engine-plant correctness here is numerical and causal; the F135 values are a calibration to public ratings with declared hypotheses (docs/validation/f135-engine-plant.md), not an F135 identification.
No wall-clock timing, browser, GPU, display or sound-device check was run.
The WASM build is not reproducible byte for byte; identity is the recorded source commit, inputs and toolchain.
